notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q1140634_puerta_de_alcala.py, tools/meshkit.py) with AI assistance. Proportions from the OpenStreetMap outline and from measurements on near-orthographic photos (±3–5 %): no published measured drawing was found. East (exterior) façade with ten engaged Ionic columns, satyr-mask keystones, garland panels, children with trophies and the royal arms with Fame and a Genius; west façade with pilasters, lion keystones, cornucopias, armour trophies and a triangular pediment inside the segmental one. Sculpture is stylised. The inscription REGE CAROLO III / ANNO / MDCCLXXVIII is on both attics.
